title: Platinum Reserve Account: Integration with Enterprise Treasury Tools
summary: This document describes Platinum Reserve Account integration options—direct file exchange with structured layouts, API-based near-real-time synchronization, and secure upload workflows for manual updates. It covers implementation support (2 dedicated relationship managers; guided mapping to chart of accounts/liquidity taxonomy), testing/validation steps, and ongoing change management via a runbook and periodic reviews.
